issues.title: Screen reader markup is broken
issues.desc: ARIA parent elements are missing required child elements.

issues.title: Your text is too hard to read
issues.desc: Text and background colors do not have enough contrast for people with low vision.

issues.title: Images missing descriptions
issues.desc: Images have no alt text, making them invisible to screen readers and users who cannot see them.

issues.title: Maps and widgets are invisible
issues.desc: Embedded maps or widgets have no title, so screen readers skip them entirely.

issues.title: Heading structure is broken
issues.desc: Headings skip levels (e.g. H1 jumps to H3), disrupting how screen readers navigate the page.

issues.title: No way to skip navigation
issues.desc: The skip navigation link does not work correctly.
